adamalshoomary-shotgun-shotgun-shotgun.description: Run the shotgun handoff system in this project, so any agent can resume work another one stopped. Use for setting up the handoff files in a new project, taking over queue work from another agent or another session, saving progress before a new chat, archiving a finished round of work, reporting queue status, or updating shotgun. Triggers on "shotgun", "set up handoff", "continue the queue", "save before a new chat", "finish this round", "what is next in the plan", "take over this project".
adamalshoomary-shotgun-shotgun-shotgun.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash, Agent, WebFetch, WebSearch
